hostLoad: Shared host: GPU jobs of cooperating agents are serialized by a lock, other host work is not; timings are observations
what: A temporary in-session probe (not committed) split one bucketed one-token request at 2,048 prompt tokens, C = 64, into encode (encode calls, which run the GPU work synchronously), cache growth, input building, join, logits read and update-row copies, in milliseconds. Two consecutive runs: the growth path as committed, then a prototype that reused large KV buffers across growths and requests.
reading: Reusing buffers cut growth by 57 ms (0.6B) and 68 ms (4B) but encode rose by 51 ms and 58 ms, so time to first token did not improve (+9 ms and -14 ms, within host noise). The reused buffer is larger than the view Core AI is given, which it pays for at encode. Rejected.
